coherence_policy: Candidate probabilities must be monotone across increasing over lines within each fixture/role or fixture/total ladder; violation blocks evidence.

SIDE_CORNERS.aggregation: pool all preregistered roles and lines; each eligible fixture-role-line cell contributes once
SIDE_CORNERS.line_results: diagnostic only; no single line may determine promotion
SIDE_CORNERS.population: all eligible DEVELOPMENT OOF fixture-role-line cells for HOME and AWAY
SIDE_CORNERS.primary_comparison: dynamic_side_nb2 minus dynamic_poisson using paired loss differences
SIDE_CORNERS.promotion_gate: mean improvement > 0 and 95% weekly-block CI lower bound > 0 for BOTH binary Log Loss and Brier
SIDE_CORNERS.role_guard: HOME and AWAY pooled role Log Loss must not have a 95% CI upper bound < 0 (material degradation)

TOTAL_CORNERS.aggregation: pool all preregistered total lines; each eligible fixture-line cell contributes once
TOTAL_CORNERS.line_results: diagnostic only; no single line may determine promotion
TOTAL_CORNERS.population: all eligible DEVELOPMENT OOF fixture-line cells for match totals
TOTAL_CORNERS.primary_comparison: convolution of side-NB2 distributions minus Poisson total distribution
TOTAL_CORNERS.promotion_gate: mean improvement > 0 and 95% weekly-block CI lower bound > 0 for BOTH binary Log Loss and Brier

missingness_policy: Missing corner outcomes are excluded, never imputed. Both candidate probabilities must exist for a paired cell.
multiplicity_policy: No best-line search. Two preregistered primary hypotheses only: SIDE_CORNERS and TOTAL_CORNERS. Role/line/competition slices are diagnostics and cannot promote a candidate by themselves.
scientific_boundary: Layer 3.1 may decide component eligibility for Layer 4. It is not calibration, market comparison, protected evaluation, or commercial evidence.
